mapping.author: claude-ontology-w3

clauses.clause: As this artifact enters, choose a creature type.
Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1.
{3}, {T}: Look at the top three cards of your library.
You may reveal a creature card of the chosen type from among them and put it into your hand.
Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

mapping.notes: Re-mapped by ontology gate round W3 (DESIGN_ATOM_ONTOLOGY §20) from the stored tree: "reveal ... from among them and put it into your hand": the move's pick, then reveal_result(). Nothing else changed.
